name: 常驻 PowerShell
description: 短 PowerShell 命令的常驻通道。每条命令使用新 Runspace，但共享进程环境；工作目录必须可解析，已提交但结果未知的命令不会重放。

en.name: Resident PowerShell
en.description: A resident daemon for short PowerShell commands. Commands use fresh Runspaces but share process-wide state. Unresolved working directories are rejected and submitted commands are never replayed.
en.safetyNotes: The daemon runs the bundled server.ps1 and communicates over stdio. Runspaces do not isolate environment writes or other process-wide state. Captured stdout and stderr share an 8 MiB UTF-8 budget per tool call.

zh-CN.description: 短 PowerShell 命令的常驻通道。每条命令使用新 Runspace，但共享进程环境；工作目录必须可解析，已提交但结果未知的命令不会重放。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: daemon 运行随附的 server.ps1，通过 stdio 通信。Runspace 不隔离环境变量写入或其他进程级状态。每次工具调用捕获的 stdout 和 stderr 共享 8 MiB UTF-8 预算。

author: local

agentTools.name: pwsh_run
agentTools.description: Run short PowerShell commands in a resident daemon. Use Bash for environment writes, process-wide state changes, long or interactive jobs, and exact exit codes. A fresh Runspace isolates variables/functions, not the process. Batches run in order by default without short-circuiting; parallel batches are for independent commands. Check each result's status: fallback=true means it did not start; unknown means it may have run, so do not replay it automatically.

command.description: One short PowerShell command. Provide command or commands.

commands.description: PowerShell commands (up to 20). Takes precedence over command. Results are returned in input order.

parallel.description: For commands[] only. Defaults to false; true runs up to four independent commands concurrently.

batchTimeoutMs.description: For commands[] only. Total time budget including setup and waiting, in milliseconds (default 90000). Unsubmitted commands are marked skipped.

cwd.description: Defaults to the workspace root. Relative paths are resolved against that root; otherwise provide an absolute filesystem path.

timeoutMs.description: Per-command execution timeout in milliseconds (1000–600000, default 60000), subject to host and batch deadlines.
